svg.title: kernelkite before and after comparison
svg.desc: Grouped bar chart. For each metric a tall red bar shows the baseline value and a shorter green bar shows the optimized value. Proportions match samples/comparison.json: duration down 33 percent, cpu down 56 percent, peak rss down 60 percent, disk read down 57 percent, disk write down 56 percent. Flat palette, no remote assets.
svg.text: baseline (red) against optimized (green), heights in proportion to real deltas
